segments.title: 第142章 別擋路
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 142 Don't Block the Way

On Friday morning, the weather was clear and sunny, and the sports meet was held as scheduled.

It started at 8 o'clock, first with the women's 800-meter race, with Wang Xinyu and Ren Zheng from Class Eight participating.

Xu Yinghuan sat in the stands cheering for her classmates, then her gaze fell on Li Luo, who was sitting one person away from Yan Zhusheng. She said with a grin, "The class president is actually sitting here this time. If a certain someone were competing, he'd probably be on the track accompanying her by now."

"This is me showing trust in our classmates," Li Luo said without a blush or a racing heart. "Besides, Fang Chen borrowed my staff pass. See? Isn't he having a great time accompanying them on the lawn?"

Generally, only students competing or those with staff passes could freely move between the stands and the field. Other students were not allowed to leave as they pleased.

Especially if one lingered on the field for too long, a patrolling member of the student council would come over to urge them to hurry back to their own class's section of the stands.

"But Ren Zheng doesn't seem to be interested in him," Xu Yinghuan said, smiling as she looked at Fang Chen on the field, tutting. "It's so tough. Can't he just focus on studying?"

"Indeed." Li Luo nodded in agreement. "I've always upheld the philosophy of studying hard to set a good example for everyone."

Xu Yinghuan: "...How can you say something like that, Class President?"

"Is there a problem?"

"You and Zhusheng..." Xu Yinghuan whispered to the two of them, "Ahem?"

"You're underestimating the pure friendship between us classmates," Li Luo said with a straight face. "You talk about studying hard, but in your heart, you're just full of gossip, aren't you?"

"I'm not," Xu Yinghuan pouted. "Everyone is talking about it in private. Who disappears together every day before the second evening self-study session is even over, and then comes back after class with both their faces flushed? Stop pretending, Class President."

"That's why I say you guys are gossips." Li Luo shook his head and sighed. "I just go down to the track with her to run. We were preparing for the sports meet early on. Why else do you think I signed up for the 3000-meter?"

"Really?" Xu Yinghuan was somewhat convinced by Li Luo, but still found it a bit hard to believe. "Zhusheng, you say something."

"It's just as Li Luo said." Yan Zhusheng nodded. "And we also go for morning runs together. He writes songs for me to sing, and I teach him how to play the guitar. We also practice together in the rock club."

Li Luo: "...You don't have to be so detailed."

But after hearing what Yan Zhusheng said and seeing the look on her face, Xu Yinghuan was actually convinced.

But her expression quickly turned sad. "I even told Tingting about it. I was kind of shipping you two. Turns out I was shipping a ghost ship? Could it be, just as Tingting said, that you and Xixi..."

"Isn't Xixi Li Luo's cousin?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and asked.

"How is that possible?" Xu Yinghuan shook her head repeatedly, then chuckled. "A lot of people in class do think that, though. It's all because that guy Zhu Yufei is too dense to even get Li Luo's jokes."

"Jin Yuting and I were both middle school classmates of Li Luo and Ying Chanxi."

"The two of them are just neighbors. What cousins?"

At these words, Yan Zhusheng immediately fell silent and turned to look at Li Luo.

"Ahem... how was I supposed to know they all took it seriously?" Li Luo said helplessly. "But it's not wrong to say I'm like her older brother, right? We've been together since we were kids, so it's no different from having a little sister."

"Oh, so that's how it is," Yan Zhusheng said with a nod of understanding.

While the few of them were chatting, the women's 800-meter race began.

Compared to yesterday's 1500-meter race, the 800-meter wasn't much better. You were half-dead with exhaustion after finishing.

The good news was that Wang Xinyu secured fourth place for Class Eight, returning triumphantly amidst the applause and cheers of her classmates.

In their class, aside from Yan Zhusheng, Wang Xinyu had the best athletic skills among the girls.

Besides placing in the 800-meter race, she also took third place in the high jump.

In comparison, Yan Zhusheng's talent for the high jump was slightly lower; she only managed eighth place.

But after the men's 1000-meter race ended today, it would soon be time for the women's 100-meter and 200-meter finals.

"Let's go, time to check in at the gymnasium," Li Luo said, taking his staff pass back from Fang Chen, then turned to Yan Zhusheng. "You have to give it your all in the finals. Try to bring back a gold medal."

First High didn't have many sports-specialty students, nor did they have one for every event. Yan Zhusheng's chances this time were quite high.

Sitting in her seat, Xu Yinghuan watched Li Luo accompany Yan Zhusheng to check in for the race, and little stars immediately appeared in her eyes.

Whether it was real or not didn't matter, as long as the shipping was sweet enough.

Inside the gymnasium.

When Ying Chanxi saw Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng walking over, she immediately waved at them.

Wearing his staff pass, Li Luo greeted Ying Chanxi and Qiao Xinyan, who had come with her, then went to the P.E. teacher to take charge of guiding this round of the finals.

The P.E. teacher opened the list and started the roll call, "Yan Zhusheng."

"Ying Chanxi."

"Luo Jiajia."

"Gao Yuqin."

It had to be said, there were quite a few familiar faces in the 100-meter finals this time.

Following the P.E. teacher's instructions, Li Luo confirmed that all eight finalists were present, then led them to the 100-meter starting line.

Here, aside from Li Luo, people like Liu Shaowen, Xie Shuchen, Lu Wei and Zhang Yuanying from Class Seven, and Li Luo's good brother Zhao Rongjun had all borrowed staff passes from classmates to come watch the race up close.

"You haven't asked yet, have you?" Li Luo walked over to Zhao Rongjun's side. Seeing him still here cheering for Luo Jiajia in person, he couldn't help but ask with a suspicious look.

"I just haven't had a suitable opportunity," Zhao Rongjun said in a low voice. "Can you not talk about this here?"

"Fine, fine," Li Luo waved his hand, not bothering with him for the time being. After a brief chat, he strolled over to Yan Zhusheng and Ying Chanxi.

"How are our two contestants preparing?"

Yan Zhusheng nodded, while Ying Chanxi nervously rubbed her small hands together.

"Don't ask. The more you ask, the more nervous I get." Ying Chanxi took a few deep breaths, but it didn't help. She was still a bit tense. It felt like her blood was flowing faster, her body was tingling, and she was all wound up.

This wasn't an exam hall, after all.

If it were an exam, in the face of absolute ability, Ying Chanxi wouldn't feel nervous at all.

But in a field she wasn't particularly skilled in, Ying Chanxi was still an ordinary girl, and she would get nervous.

In contrast, Yan Zhusheng's personality made it hard for her to get nervous.

Perhaps it was her indifferent attitude towards winning and losing itself, so Yan Zhusheng's expression was always calm. She didn't look like someone about to compete in the finals at all.

Soon, the teacher in charge began to call the contestants to get ready.

The eight contestants lined up at the starting line, creating a beautiful sight.

Putting other things aside, just in terms of looks, the lineup for this year's Grade 10 100-meter finals was truly splendid.

Not only were there two school-level beauties, Ying Chanxi and Yan Zhusheng, holding down the fort, but there were also others like Luo Jiajia and Gao Yuqin who were quite pretty.

As a result, it wasn't just the Grade 10 students, but even many from Grade 11 and 12 were casting their gazes in this direction.

"The 3000-meter race is this afternoon." Lu Wei walked up to Li Luo at this moment and said with a chuckle, "Still remember our bet?"

Li Luo: "...When did I make a bet with you? Big brother, can you get your head straight?"

"Hmph," Lu Wei snorted coldly. "Just you wait."

On the other side, Liu Shaowen stood very close to Li Luo. He glanced at Lu Wei, who had come over to act cocky, and asked strangely, "What's with that guy? Is he also running the 3000-meter this afternoon?"

"His brain doesn't work too well," Li Luo's lips twitched. "This guy likes that girl named Gao Yuqin, but Gao Yuqin often comes to chat with me, and this is the result."

"What kind of situation is that?" Liu Shaowen immediately burst out laughing. "If you like a girl, just go after her yourself. What's the point of getting angry at someone else?"

"That makes sense," Xie Shuchen said with a nod. "But a certain someone shouldn't have double standards. How did you mock me yesterday?"

Liu Shaowen coughed a few times, a little embarrassed. "That's a different matter. Stop talking nonsense, the race is about to start."

The teacher in charge stood outside the starting line, having already raised the small flag in his hand, signaling the teacher at the finish line.

The eight runners on the track also got into their starting stances, ready to sprint at any moment.

In the stands, students from every class that had someone in the finals were now on their feet.

Even someone like Xiuxiu, who loved to memorize vocabulary, had taken the initiative to come to the edge of the stands to cheer for her own classmate.

"Ying Chanxi!"

"Ying Chanxi!"

"Yan Zhusheng!"

"Yan Zhusheng!"

Among them, the cheers for Ying Chanxi and Yan Zhusheng were the most distinct.

And in this heated atmosphere, the teacher in charge had already raised the starting pistol, shouting loudly:

"On your marks, get set—go!"

With a gunshot, eight figures shot out like arrows.

Luo Jiajia and Yan Zhusheng took the lead, with Ying Chanxi and Gao Yuqin following closely behind.

By the time the eight of them reached the 50-meter mark, the gap had already begun to widen.

Ying Chanxi gradually fell back to fourth or fifth place, gritting her teeth and trying hard to push forward.

Yan Zhusheng, on the other hand, slowly surpassed Luo Jiajia by half a body length, her long legs swinging back and forth.

Li Luo and the others all ran quickly towards the finish line at this moment, wanting to witness this moment.

But just as Yan Zhusheng smoothly crossed the finish line, a series of gasps erupted from the stands.

Just as Ying Chanxi was about to reach the finish line, perhaps because she was in a hurry, she stumbled and pitched forward, falling right onto the finish line.

"Ying Chanxi!"

Seeing this, Liu Shaowen and Xie Shuchen's eyes widened in horror, and they ran madly towards Ying Chanxi.

But Li Luo's reaction was much faster than theirs. The moment Ying Chanxi lost her balance, his heart skipped a beat.

Before his mind could even process it, his body was already running in that direction.

But no one expected that the fastest person to reach Ying Chanxi's side was another tall figure.

"Xixi, how are you? Where are you hurt?" Yan Zhusheng had appeared by Ying Chanxi's side at some point, squatting down to ask about her condition with concern and check her injuries.

Ying Chanxi bit her lip tightly, but tears of pain still dripped down one by one. She sucked in a breath, enduring the pain, and said in a small voice, "My elbow... my wrist hurts too, and I think my knee..."

As Ying Chanxi spoke, the people around her quickly gathered, each one expressing their concern.

Yan Zhusheng, however, said in a rare, cold voice, "Everyone step back, don't block the way, move."

With that, she reached out, scooped up Ying Chanxi's body in a princess carry, and without even acknowledging the classmate who came to call her to receive her award, she carried Ying Chanxi towards the infirmary without a backward glance.

(End of Chapter)
